listing.title: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair Hackathon | Superteam NL Track
listing.description:
About Superteam Netherlands

Superteam Netherlands is all about helping out and growing the Solana ecosystem in the Netherlands. We're a local chapter of Superteam. This track is our local prize pool specifically for Dutch teams participating in the Crypto World's Fair hackathon. You build your project for the main global hackathon, submit it there, and if you're a top Dutch team, you can win extra prizes from us on top of anything you might win globally!

Mission

Encourage and reward the best NL talent participating in the Crypto World's Fair hackathon by providing a local prize pool.

Hackathon Track Scope

This track is designed to amplify the efforts of Dutch builders in the Crypto World's Fair hackathon. To be eligible for this prize pool, you must:

  • Register for the Crypto World's Fair hackathon on Colosseum.

  • Ensure your country is set to "Netherlands" in your Colosseum profile.

  • Submit your project to the main Crypto World's Fair hackathon.

  • Your project should demonstrate innovation and technical skill within the blockchain space.

  • The project must be built on Solana.

Submission Requirements

  • Your project must be submitted to the main Crypto World's Fair hackathon on the Colosseum platform.

  • All team members must be added to your Colosseum project.

  • A clear pitch and a separate technical demo of your project are required as part of your main hackathon submission.

  • The application, videos, deck, and repository linked in your Colosseum submission must be accessible to reviewers.

Judging Criteria

  • Ecosystem Impact: does the project contribute real value through infrastructure, tooling, or a product people need?

  • Product-Market Fit: is there a clear problem, a defined user, and early signs that the solution works?

  • Growth Potential: can the project attract new users or deepen engagement among existing ones?

Rewards

Total pool: $5,000

  • 1st place: $2,000

  • 2nd place: $1,000

  • 3rd place: $500

  • Best student team: $500 (a team where most members are students)

  • Best first-time team: $1000 (your first Colosseum hackathon)
